name: PLSC 1100
title: Turfgrass Management
description: An overview of turfgrass adaptation, selection, and management. Topics include turfgrass growth, physiology, soil interactions, establishment, and maintenance. Cultural system practices for lawns, golf courses, athletic fields, and other turf areas. Turfgrass pest management practices for weeds, insects, and diseases. Taught with SAPL 110. Formerly offered as SPSS 1100.
requirement_description: May not be taken out of sequence after passing PLSC 3150.
